label: Backward propagation
subgoals: Assign observability 0 to every primary output
Add the output observability, the other inputs' non-controlling costs and one
Process gates in reverse topological order

label: Fanout stems
subgoals: Compute the observability of each fanout branch separately
Take the minimum over the branches for the stem
Recognize the minimum as optimistic under correlation

label: Detection difficulty
subgoals: Add the controllability of the opposite value to the observability
Rank faults by this estimate to predict hard faults
Place observation points at lines with large observability
